value.resampling: whole dependency groups with replacement; sum divided by sampled item count
value.secondary_policy: 20 contrasts; centered bootstrap max-t, one shared 95% interval family

value.interpretation: descriptive learned-map locations; identity191 excluded; no selected-cell pointwise interval

value.target: 17 nominal sum classes a+b; same outer unordered-pair folds
value.locations: five original inner-selected loop-1 physical layers, fixed
value.learning_curve: 18 versus 36 pairs; 3 deterministic class-covering subsets per fold
value.C_check: one added C=10 chosen only if existing inner-validation accuracy improves
value.optimization_check: same C/full data with tol=1e-6 versus 1e-4; max_iter=4000 versus2000
value.uncertainty: 20,000 paired eligible-pair cluster resamples; fixed selections and subsets

value.policy: centered bootstrap max-t, 4 contrasts, 20000 whole-group draws

value.definition: controls = the 7 other concept names in the item's benchmark domain (subset of the frozen 79); pass-4 band 169–180; fit01 vs raw

bound_check.note: lower bound on the observed point estimate; not an interval or a substitute for the estimate

value.visible_input: exactly token_ids (BOS + prompt tokens up to the common-prefix boundary); one item per forward; no wrapper, demonstrations, chat template, prefilled response or padding; readout at position −1 so all tokens are causally visible
value.semantic_clue_review: not automatable; substring/word matches listed in OVERLAP_LEDGER.csv for manual review
value.caveat: zero exact token overlap does not establish absence of semantic information or pretraining contamination

S1_control_filtering.rule: drop exact-token-overlapping controls for the affected items, both methods; denominators recorded

S2_clean_subset.rule: drop affected items entirely, both methods
